description: Source code for a stripped-down version of gettext's envsubst utility, used for environment variable substitution in shell strings, with some project-specific modifications and licensing comments.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, performing environment variable substitution, and closing stderr.

methods.name: find_variables
methods.description: Parses a string to find variable patterns like $VAR or ${VAR} and invokes a callback for each variable found.

methods.name: print_variable
methods.description: Outputs a variable name followed by a newline.

methods.name: print_variables
methods.description: Finds and prints all variables in a string.

methods.name: string_list_init
methods.description: Initializes a dynamic list of strings.

methods.name: string_list_append
methods.description: Appends a string to a dynamic list.

methods.name: sorted_string_list_member
methods.description: Checks if a sorted list contains a specific string.

methods.name: note_variable
methods.description: Adds a variable name to the set of variables to substitute.

methods.name: note_variables
methods.description: Extracts variables from a string and stores them in a set.

methods.name: do_getc
methods.description: Reads a character from stdin with error checking.

methods.name: do_ungetc
methods.description: Pushes a character back onto stdin.

methods.name: subst_from_stdin
methods.description: Copies stdin to stdout, performing variable substitution based on environment variables and user options.
